dedupe_keys.name: chile national public infrastructure plan 2025 2055 pnip project portfolio and maps

description: The National Public Infrastructure Plan 2025-2055 (PNIP) of the Chilean Ministry of Public Works is a 30-year plan that brings together public and private, regional and national infrastructure proposals in four priority areas: connectivity and territorial integration, habitability of towns, water security and energy security. Its project portfolio, updated to January 2026, holds 24,589 projects worth 417 trillion Chilean pesos: over 3,300 connectivity projects, over 14,200 habitability projects, over 7,200 water security projects and over 1,500 energy security projects; at the launch on 4 September 2025 it held 22,244 projects. The site has a PNIP in figures section with indicators of demography, economy, climate, water demand and transport, past, present and projected, and a download page with the executive summary, the full plan book, national maps of the four areas, a synthesis of the origin of the portfolio (January 2026) and three base studies, all as PDF. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the portfolio is presented as totals and maps in PDF, not as a project-level table, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is Chile. It supports capacity planning and multi-sector investment analysis of transport, water, energy and urban infrastructure; related records are the Te Waihanga pipeline of New Zealand and GeoMOP of Chile.
